stories.title: Sources: Lions DE Hutchinson feared to have suffered significant knee injury
stories.summary: Lions star Aidan Hutchinson is feared to have suffered a significant injury to his right knee while celebrating a sack, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: LSU's Fulwiley arrested after allegedly fleeing scene of traffic stop
stories.summary: LSU guard MiLaysia Fulwiley was arrested after she allegedly drove her car into a police vehicle while attempting to flee from a traffic stop.

stories.title: Patriots QB Maye injures ankle on Hutchinson sack, to have further testing
stories.summary: Patriots quarterback Drake Maye suffered an ankle injury in Sunday's loss to the Lions.

stories.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown on celebrating Lions' win in Germany: 'Like a dream come true'
stories.summary: Amon-Ra St. Brown, who spent childhood summers visiting Germany, said Sunday after the Lions' win in Munich that this is a trip he'll "never forget."

stories.title: Rory, fighting tears, dedicates latest Dubai title to ailing father: 'This one's for him'
stories.summary: Rory McIlroy captured the seasonlong Race to Dubai golf title for a record-tying eighth time when he secured a top-two finish at the World Tour Championship.
